title: The first dog in space was never coming back 🐕🚀
caption:
She orbited the Earth before any human. This is her story 🐕💔
Remember Laika 👇
sources: NASA, 'Sputnik 2' (launched 3 November 1957 with the dog Laika)
Malashenkov D. (2002), World Space Congress, Houston: Laika died of overheating within hours of launch
Oleg Gazenko (1998) quoted by the BBC/Moscow News: 'We did not learn enough from the mission to justify the death of the dog'
Laika monument in Moscow (2008), a dog standing on a rocket
